spanish: Y el tabernáculo harás diez cortinas; lino fino torcido y azul y púrpura y carmesí; querubines, obra de pensador, harás a ellos.

units.es: Y el tabernáculo harás diez cortinas

grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated lemma 'mishkán' into Spanish as 'tabernáculo' for הַמִּשְׁכָּן (definite article + masculine singular common noun), matching the fix already applied at Éxodo 25:9.
Changed 'ellas' to 'ellos' so the pronoun agrees in gender with the Hebrew suffix אֹתָם (3rd person masculine plural), which matches masculine plural 'querubines' rather than feminine 'cortinas'.
readerNote: Chose 'ellos' over 'ellas' because the Hebrew suffix is masculine plural, agreeing grammatically with 'querubines' and not with the feminine 'cortinas'.
